diagnosis: The recruitment AI agent tool endpoint fetches candidate evaluation scorecards and background notes directly using the user-provided candidateId. It lacks validation against the authenticated hiring manager's department or assigned requisition listings. Any recruiter or hiring manager can extract private compensation demands, reference check feedback, and executive interview appraisals for candidates outside their hiring scope.
